title: Dark phone macro tour with glowing name close
summary: Four tight macro shots of a dark phone (hero art, score rings, suggestion card, hero again) on hard cuts, the whole phone rises out of black, fades, then the name and a short tagline glow in on black.
use_when: A mobile app with one striking hero visual on its home screen
Premium, moody 9:16 teaser where the device is the set
An app whose home screen shows a score or a few ring metrics
Closing on name plus a 3-word tagline instead of a URL card

look.type_style: UI: rounded grotesk, glowing pale-mint numerals; close: medium grotesk, sentence case, normal tracking, ~2 % H, centred, grey with a mint glow pass

sfx.event: each hard cut between macro shots
whole phone rises out of black
name glow and tagline glow pass
music drops out under the tagline and credit line (audio.json silence 22.50-27.71)

structure.shot: macro of a dark phone's top corner, tilted; home screen: time, glowing wordmark, a gem on rock in a dark cave
structure.camera: slow lateral drift, -140 px/s (1920 basis), roll -2 deg/s, push 1.00 -> ~1.05 over 108 fr (motion.json)
structure.motion: camera only; screen static; easings.linear drift (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: tilted close-up of the score block: big number, three ring metric pills, a suggestion card falling out of focus below
structure.camera: drift the other way, +125 px/s, roll +1 deg/s, slow pull back ~-1.5 %/s; shallow depth of field, focus on the top third
structure.motion: camera only; blur on lower card grows across the shot (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: bottom edge of the phone at a steep angle: suggestion card with a button and a tab bar; rim light on the chamfer
structure.camera: drift -125 px/s, roll +3 deg/s, push ~+1 %/s; rack-focus from soft to sharp on the card
structure.motion: camera only; focus settles by ~9.00 (sheet-03 cell 4) (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: very tight tilted shot of the hero gem on the screen, wordmark and score blurred at the edges
structure.camera: push-in accelerating 4.5 -> 9 %/s with a tilt up (-140 px/s vertical), easings.inOutSine (±0.25 s)
structure.motion: camera only; gem glows brighter as it nears frame centre

structure.shot: black frame with a soft overhead light; the whole phone rises from the bottom edge, small, then grows to ~70 % frame height
structure.camera: dolly up and toward the phone: phone ~0.2 H at 15.00 -> ~0.7 H at 16.00, springs.heavy (overshoot not measurable)
structure.motion: phone enters at ~14.75 from below, settles ~16.50 (±0.25 s); screen wakes from dark as it rises

structure.shot: full phone, front-on, floating in a soft spotlight showing the full home screen
structure.camera: near static hold with a tiny float, < 1 %/s
structure.motion: phone fades to black 18.00 -> 18.50, easings.inOutSine 15 fr (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: black with a faint radial vignette; product name small at centre
structure.motion: name blur-in 18.77 -> 19.27 (~15 fr, easings.outQuint); mint glow halo builds to 20.00, dims to grey by 20.27 (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: the name gains a period and a 3-word tagline on the same centred line
structure.motion: tagline word-reveal left to right 20.77 -> 21.50 while the line recentres; mint glow pass runs over the new words 21.27 -> 21.77, then all grey by 22.00; hold (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: small grey sign-off line, 3 words, centred on black
structure.motion: line swaps in on one cell (±0.25 s); holds ~3.5 s; fades out from ~27.20

params.brand: brand.json: dark bg, pale-mint accent for UI glow and the glow pass, display font
params.content.homeScreen: one home screen: wordmark, hero art, a score with 3 ring metrics, one suggestion card, tab bar
params.content.heroArt: image or 3D still of the hero object (shot 1 and 4)
params.content.name: product name for the close
params.content.tagline: 3-word tagline that extends the name on one line
params.timing.shot: macro shot length in frames at 30 fps (reference ~107)

notes: Macro shots are a real 3D render of a phone with depth of field; the studio PhoneFrame is flat, so device-3d needs a model or a pre-rendered plate. Cut rhythm: 4 shots of 3.27-3.60 s, cut_on_beat 2/4 (3.60 and 14.03 land on beats). The cut at 14.03 goes to black with the phone emerging; it reads as a smash-cut-black but the music continues, so it is tagged hard-cut. Camera numbers from motion.json, not from strips; entrance frames are at 0.25 s sheet resolution. Glow pass along the tagline is a proposed term (glow-sweep). SFX other than the silence are planned by the glue rule, not measured; the reference is music-only.
